patriot.title: Patriot
patriot.synopsis: A spy thriller that follows Dr. Daniel James, a scientific analyst, as he uncovers a massive surveillance conspiracy involving Periscope — a powerful spyware capable of remotely accessing cameras, microphones, and private data on any civilian device — being weaponized by political heavyweight J.P. Sundaram and his son. The Mammootty–Mohanlal reunion after 18 years.
patriot.verdict_text: Strong Malayalam opener — cleared ₹26 Cr nett India in W1 with solid Kerala holds and overseas multiplier. ZEE5 holds digital rights. WW ₹73 Cr lifetime locks ATB tier among 2026 Malayalam releases.

mortal-kombat-ii.title: Mortal Kombat II
mortal-kombat-ii.producers: Todd Garner · James Wan · E. Bennett Walsh
cast: Hiroyuki Sanada as Hanzo Hasashi / Scorpion
mortal-kombat-ii.synopsis: The fan-favourite champions — now joined by Johnny Cage himself — are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds-barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of Earthrealm and its defenders. Sequel to 2021's Mortal Kombat.
mortal-kombat-ii.verdict_text: India Day 1 ₹1.40 Cr nett — Hollywood mid-tier opener vs Bollywood/regional clutter. Global $65M opening weekend tracker (Variety) — full WW number locks Sun May 10 EOD. Premiered at TCL Chinese Theater April 27.

daadi-ki-shaadi.title: Daadi Ki Shaadi
daadi-ki-shaadi.producers: Ashish R. Mohan · Bunty Rathore · Saahil S. Sharma
cast: R. Sarathkumar as Col. Theeran Devarajan
daadi-ki-shaadi.synopsis: A lonely grandmother's social media mishap about an upcoming 'marriage' creates havoc for her granddaughter's wedding — prompting Tony Kalra to mend deep family rifts. A heartfelt comedy-drama about ageing, loneliness, and second chances. Marks Riddhima Kapoor Sahni's Bollywood debut alongside her mother Neetu Kapoor.
daadi-ki-shaadi.verdict_text: Family-comedy mid-budget opener leaning on Kapoor-family debut buzz (Riddhima + Samara). Day 1 ₹0.50 Cr is on the softer end — needs strong word-of-mouth + family multiplexes through weekend to recover. Alia Bhatt's social endorsement helped trigger trial.

krishnavataram-part-1.title: Krishnavataram Part 1: The Heart
krishnavataram-part-1.producers: Sajan Raj Kurup · Shobha Sant · Poonam Shroff · Parth Gajjar
krishnavataram-part-1.synopsis: A mythological narrative reimagining Lord Krishna's journey from Dwarka to Kurukshetra after parting with Radha — explored through Satyabhama's perspective, based on Raam Mori's literary work. Part 1 of a planned multi-part saga.
krishnavataram-part-1.verdict_text: Devotional opener with strong pre-release interest (42K+ BookMyShow 'interested' in Telugu/Hindi belts). Day 2 +30.9% over Day 1 = positive trial spike. Reviews praising Siddharth Gupta as Krishna, Pinterest-aesthetic visuals. Path-to-profit depends on devotional-circuit holds + diaspora.

dridam.title: Dridam
dridam.producers: Mukesh R. Mehta · C.V. Sarathi · E4 Experiments × Bedtime Stories (Jeethu Joseph)
cast: Shane Nigam as S.I. Vijay Radhakrishnan
dridam.synopsis: A rookie police officer arrives at a hill-station posting under intense pressure to solve a murder case within a week after human remains are discovered. A tightly-edited Malayalam investigative thriller from director Martin Joseph (debut) under Jeethu Joseph's Bedtime Stories banner.
dridam.verdict_text: Mid-week Kerala opener — 7+ audience reviews praising Shane Nigam's restraint and Martin Joseph's editorial discipline. Critics note structural weakness in final act but film does not collapse. Path to recovery depends on Kerala weekend uplift + word-of-mouth.

godari-gattupaina.title: Godari Gattupaina
godari-gattupaina.synopsis: Set in the picturesque Godavari villages, Godari Gattupaina follows a kind-hearted auto driver and a spirited college girl whose sweet love story faces challenges from family expectations and village conflicts. A debutant director's emotional rural romance.
godari-gattupaina.verdict_text: Telugu rural-romance opener (paid premieres a day earlier). Day 1 ₹0.70 Cr — modest but on-band for the budget tier. Jagapathi Babu's anchor presence helps trial. Two Telugu Friday clutter (vs Sathi Leelavathi) splits the family-romance audience.

sathi-leelavathi.title: Sathi Leelavathi
sathi-leelavathi.synopsis: A successful film director Leelavathi marries psychologist Ram Sethu after her childhood traumas about her parents' marriage are healed in therapy. Three years in, when Sethu announces a divorce and an affair, Leelavathi locks him inside their home — triggering a rollercoaster of comedy, emotion, and reconciliation. Lavanya Tripathi's post-marriage comeback.
sathi-leelavathi.verdict_text: Soft Day 1 at ₹0.30 Cr — Lavanya comeback awareness was higher than ticket conversion. Reviews lean positive on Lavanya's comic timing and the marriage-counselling premise. Family multiplexes weekend uplift is the only real recovery path now.

ankam-attahasam.title: Ankam Attahasam
ankam-attahasam.synopsis: 24-year-old Ajay Chandran gets drawn into the dangerous underworld of Trivandrum while confronting hidden secrets from his past. A Malayalam-language action thriller written by G. Anil Kumar and Sujith S. Nair, set against the city's gritty street circuits.
ankam-attahasam.verdict_text: Soft Malayalam opening for a debut-led action thriller — competing directly against Dridam (Shane Nigam) for the same Kerala thriller audience. Day 1 ₹0.20 Cr puts it in disaster-warning territory unless weekend lifts +50%+.
